rules.statement: Prescription for a claim of damages arising from seduction begins to run from the date of defloration.
rules.supporting_quote: Real injuries include seducing a virgin (48.5.1.). The foundation of the Roman-Dutch law action for seduction of a virgin arises from the injury to herself. I am therefore of opinion that the section governing the claim is section 10 of Ordinance No. 22 of 1871, which enacts that no action shall be maintainable for any loss, injury, or damages unless the same shall be commenced within two years from the time when the cause of action shall have arisen.
